user.title: SeltronHome Clausius
user.description: Connect to SeltronHome for status monitoring and narrowly verified WDC controls. Email and password are stored locally in Home Assistant for automatic sign-in, without separate encryption. They may be included in backups; protect your configuration and backups.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect SeltronHome
reauth_confirm.description: Sign in again with the same SeltronHome account. Email and password are stored locally in Home Assistant for automatic sign-in, without separate encryption. They may be included in backups; protect your configuration and backups.

reconfigure.title: Save SeltronHome credentials
reconfigure.description: Use the same account as originally configured. Email and password are stored locally in Home Assistant for automatic sign-in, without separate encryption. They may be included in backups; protect your configuration and backups.

error.wrong_account: Use the same SeltronHome account that was configured originally

abort.already_configured: This SeltronHome account is already configured
abort.reauth_entry_missing: The SeltronHome configuration entry no longer exists

init.title: Polling and channel labels
init.description: Choose the polling interval and optional local display labels. Stable channel codes and unique IDs are not changed. The suggested values show the cloud names.

error.invalid_label: A label or channel is invalid
